summary: Implemented background job queue for reliable reminder email delivery using Bull with Redis. Created src/services/job-queue.js with Bull queue initialization (Redis via REDIS_URL), createReminderJob and processQueue functions with 3-attempt retry using exponential backoff (5s base), and automatic cleanup of completed jobs after 1 hour. Created src/services/email-service.js with sendReminderEmail that checks user unsubscribe_status and snooze_until before sending via nodemailer/SMTP. Created api/jobs/send-reminders.js POST endpoint accepting messageId, userId, scheduledTime with validation and authentication. Updated eslint.config.js to add Node.js globals for server-side files.
